SUBJECT: B.M. Sklarsky - information re.

With reference to the attached communication
enquiries revealed the following information:-

Mr. Boris Moiseyevich Sklarsky alias Skliarsky
alias Klaske, Russian of Jewish extraction, was born on
April 29th, 1895, in Nikolaev, South Russia. He
arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in 1920. After a brief
stay here he proceeded to Tientsin where he became the
editor of a Russian newspaper "Russkoe Slovo," from 1920
to 1923, after which he was employed in a fur store and
later conducted his own commercial business. In 1929
he departed for the United States from which country he
arrived in Shanghai in Sept. 1930.

Here he was employed as an inspector and expert
in the Rat Extermination and Fumigation Department of
the National Quarantine Service, from Febr. 1931 to Febr.
1932, after which he was without fixed employment until
1935 working as an agent on a commission basis in the
sale of unclaimed goods on behalf of various local
shipping companies.

Since Aug. 1935, Sklarsky is connected as a
fumigator and disinfector with the Shanghai Land Invest-
ment Co., 100 Jinkee Road, and resides together with his
wife at 65 Park Road, Apt. 403.

In July, 1936, a complaint of misappropriation
was made against him to the S.M. Police, but was later
withdrawn by the complainant (Misc. Rep. 508/36C.).

Otherwise he did not come to the notice of the
S.M. Police in connection with any activities of an
undesirable nature.

A.C. (Special Branch).

主题：B.M. Sklarsky - 相关信息。

关于所附函件，经查询获悉以下信息：

鲍里斯·莫伊谢耶维奇·斯克拉尔斯基（Boris Moiseyevich Sklarsky），别名斯克利阿尔斯基（Skliarsky），别名克拉斯克（Klaske），犹太裔俄国人，1895年4月29日出生于南俄罗斯尼古拉耶夫。他于1920年从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此短暂停留后，他前往天津，并于1920年至1923年间担任俄文报纸《俄语世界》（Russkoe Slovo）的编辑，此后他在一家皮草店受雇，后来经营自己的商业生意。1929年他前往美国，并于1930年9月从该国抵达上海。

在此期间，他从1931年2月至1932年2月受雇于国家检疫服务处灭鼠与熏蒸部，担任检查员和专家，此后直到1935年他没有固定职业，作为代理人以佣金方式代表各家本地航运公司销售无人认领的货物。

自1935年8月起，斯克拉尔斯基作为熏蒸和消毒人员与静安寺路100号上海地产投资公司（Shanghai Land Investment Co.）有关联，并与妻子居住在公园路65号403室公寓。

1936年7月，有人向工部局警务处指控他挪用公款，但投诉人后来撤回了投诉（杂项报告 508/36C.）。

除此之外，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

A.C.（特务科）。

PUBLIC HEALTH DEPARTMENT.
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, December 29th. 1942

To Mr. W. H. Widdowson,
Superintendent.

Dear Widdowson,

It would be much appreciated if you could obtain some
information regarding the character and reliability of a Mr. KLASKE
who is, or has been, employed with the S'hai Land Investment Co.

This gentleman has offered his services in organising food
kitchens. Dr. Jordan would like to know something about him.

Many thanks

W. J. Silvey
Chief Inspector.

这位先生已主动提出协助组织食品厨房。乔丹博士希望了解他的一些情况。

多谢

Boris Moiseyevitch SKLIARSKY; Russian Jew, was born on April 29, 1895 at Nikolaev, Herson Province, South Russia. According to his own statement, he left Vladivostok for Shanghai via Harbin in 1920. After a few months stay here he proceeded to Tientsin where he was the editor of the Russian newspaper "Russkoe Slovo" from 1920 to 1923, after which he was employed in a local fur store for a period and later conducted his own commercial business. In 1929 he left for the United States from which country he arrived in Shanghai in September, 1930.

Here he was employed as an inspector and expert in the Rat Extermination and Fumigation Department of the National Quarantine Service from February 1931 to February 1932, after which he was without fixed employment until 1935 working as an agent on a commission basis in the sale of unclaimed goods on behalf of various shipping companies, wharfs, etc.

From August 22, 1935 he has been working as a fumigator for the Shanghai Land Investment Co., San Peh Steam Navigation Co., etc.

鲍里斯·莫伊谢耶维奇·斯克利阿尔斯基（Boris Moiseyevitch SKLIARSKY）；俄国犹太人，1895年4月29日出生于南俄罗斯赫尔松省尼古拉耶夫。据其自称，他于1920年经哈尔滨从符拉迪沃斯托克前往上海。在此停留数月后，他前往天津，并于1920年至1923年间担任俄文报纸《俄语世界》（Russkoe Slovo）的编辑，此后他在当地一家皮草店受雇一段时间，后来经营自己的商业生意。1929年他前往美国，并于1930年9月从该国抵达上海。

在此期间，他从1931年2月至1932年2月受雇于国家检疫服务处灭鼠与熏蒸部，担任检查员和专家，此后直到1935年他没有固定职业，作为代理人以佣金方式代表各家航运公司、码头等销售无人认领的货物。

自1935年8月22日起，他一直担任上海地产投资公司、三北轮船公司（San Peh Steam Navigation Co.）等的熏蒸员。

他在慕尔鸣路118/1号的俄国侨民委员会以及法公董局警务处（登记号 8608-131）注册，目前与妻子伊丽莎白·M·斯克利阿尔斯基夫人（娘家姓 **〔此处转录不清〕**）居住在公园路65号403室公寓。

Canberra, Australia" to the effect that neither myself nor of
my wife were in prison.
    I intend to emigrate to Australia and the above certi-
ficate issued by the respective police authorities is one of
the documents required.
    I was residing in Shanghai since the year 1950 and my
present address is Ascot Apt.No.ICI.
                                Yours truly,
                                Boris Skliarsky
                                (Mr.Boris Skliarsky)

上海，1938 年 2 月 22 日

致警务处处长
上海工部局。

先生：
    冒昧恳请阁下出具一份致“澳大利亚堪培拉内政部秘书”的证明，
说明我本人及我的妻子均未入狱服刑。
    我打算移民澳大利亚，而上述由相关警察当局出具的证明是所需文件之一。
    我自 1950 年起居住于上海，现住址为阿斯科特公寓 ICI 号。
                                此致
                                鲍里斯·斯克利阿尔斯基
